supportingSources.label: Bob's Guide to Eight Ball Deluxe

strategy.summary: Clear the seven right drop targets and hit the lit 8-ball to complete a rack. Build two early racks, then multiply the carried Super Bonus.

steps.text: On balls 1 and 2, shoot the seven right drop targets from the left flipper.
When all seven are down, make the lit 8-ball target your first priority.
Complete the rack to lock 56,000 into Super Bonus. Complete a second rack to reach 112,000.
modeNotes: Super Bonus: Completed-rack value that carries for the full game and is added before the bonus multiplier.

steps.text: After the first rack, use the right flipper for the left orbit. Its value rises to 70,000.
On rack 2 or later, shoot the left inline drops from the left flipper to reach 5x bonus.
On ball 3, compare the score gap with the value of one more multiplier target. Take the points that can win.

fallback.title: Left orbit
fallback.when: Use this plan when the right drop bank does not return safely.

steps.text: Repeat the left orbit from the right flipper.
Stop only when its bumper return is no longer controlled.
After the orbit reaches 70,000, each full shot scores 70,000 plus a top-lane award.

alternatives.title: Late bonus collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan when Super Bonus is large, the upper-right saucer is reliable, and this machine multiplies the collect.

steps.text: Confirm that the saucer collect includes Bonus X before prioritizing it.
modeNotes: Confirm the installed setting before treating the saucer as a multiplied bonus collect.

steps.text: Complete a rack to add 56,000 to carried Super Bonus. Hit the left inline drops to raise Bonus X before collecting.
Shoot the saucer behind the 8-ball to collect the multiplied bonus. If the collect is unmultiplied, stay with racks and the left orbit.

alternatives.title: Bank Shot
alternatives.when: Use this plan when one controlled shot can secure the match.

steps.text: Backhand the target behind the inline drops for 50,000 when that value is enough.
Clear the seven right drops and hit the lit 8-ball to complete a rack and lock 56,000 into Super Bonus.
Complete a second rack to reach the 112,000 Super Bonus maximum.
After the racks, shoot the four left inline drops to raise the end-of-ball multiplier to 5X.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: From a controlled flipper, backhand the target behind the inline drops for 50,000. Use it only when that score can secure the match.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper 8-ball shot
techniques.instruction: Use the upper flipper when it gives a softer angle to the 8-ball target than a lower-flipper shot.

cautions.issue: Shots across the right drop bank create side-to-side motion toward the outlanes.
cautions.response: Shoot upward into the bank from the left flipper. Do not use a flat cross-playfield angle.

cautions.issue: The 8-ball target can rebound down the middle.
cautions.response: Use the upper flipper when it gives a softer, cleaner angle. Watch the first target return before you repeat it.

cautions.issue: The left-orbit bumper exit has two common center-drain paths.
cautions.response: Test the exit early. Stop looping the orbit when the bumpers repeatedly send the ball toward the center.

cautions.issue: Inline bonus targets can rebound down the middle.
cautions.response: Shoot them from the left flipper. This angle usually gives the safer return.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Complete one rack on each of the first two balls.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Complete two racks to lock 112,000 in Super Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Left orbit: Use this plan when the right drop bank does not return safely.

checkBeforePlay: Check target spotting, saucer collect, and whether DELUXE resets the rack.
Test the Bank Shot return, spinner, and target rebounds.
strategy.overview: The right drop bank and lit 8-ball complete racks that build carried Super Bonus, making early racks more valuable than early multipliers. After one or two racks, use the left inline drops for Bonus X; the left orbit, Bank Shot, and corner-pocket collect are later alternatives when their returns are safer.
strategy.simpleOverview: Clear the seven right drops and hit the lit 8-ball to complete a rack, then repeat on the next ball. Once the carried bonus is large, raise Bonus X at the left inline drops; use the left orbit when the bank is unsafe.
machineSetup: Check target spotting, saucer collect, and whether DELUXE resets the rack.
Test the Bank Shot return, spinner, and target rebounds.
